statement: Claude Code does not reconnect a stdio MCP server that exited, so the process it talks to must stay up.
On Windows, Claude Code was reported ignoring tools/list_changed for new tools in versions up to at least 2.1.215.
reloaderoo restarts the server when the agent calls its restart_server tool, not on its own when files change.
mcpmon restarts the server on every watched file change, with no check for running work.
log runs long jobs (queue runs, watches) inside the MCP server process, so killing that process kills them.
log already has catalog tools (logSearch, logGet, logCall) that reach any command by id, including ones added after the client started.
